questions.q: (a) Explain why cracking is carried out, using the supply and demand table on the sheet [3]. (b) State the conditions [2]. (c) Draw the repeat unit of poly(chloroethene) from CH₂=CHCl [2]. (d) Give one problem of disposing of it by burning [1].
questions.a: (a) more long-chain fractions supplied than needed (1); more demand for short chains such as petrol (1); cracking converts long into short and makes alkenes for polymers (1); (b) silica/alumina catalyst (1), 600 to 700 °C (1); (c) -[CH₂-CHCl]ₙ- with extension bonds (2); (d) releases toxic gases such as hydrogen chloride (1)
questions.model: Teacher reads the table: 'Fuel oil: supply 20%, demand 10%; gasoline: supply 10%, demand 25%.'

questions.q: Explain how car engines produce nitrogen oxides and why they are a problem.
questions.a: High temperature in the engine (1) makes nitrogen and oxygen from air react (1); NOₓ dissolve in rain to cause acid rain (1)
